summary: Implements the repo-wide public-API dual-arity law: a ts-morph scan of apps/packages/infra that finds exported 2-3-positional-parameter helpers, checks they use `dual` from effect/Function (plus ObjectLike third-param and first-param heuristics), reconciles findings against the committed standards/dual-arity.inventory.jsonc baseline, and reports/writes a summary consumed by lawsDualArityCommand in Laws.command.ts.

concerns.name: Heuristic configuration constants
concerns.description: Inline policy knobs: inventory path, scan globs, enforced roots, non-pipeable first-parameter names, pipeable-name/Effect-Schema-type/React-name regexes, schema-callable-factory pattern, dual-mapper factory names.

concerns.name: Schemas and codecs
concerns.description: LiteralKit domains and S.Class models for inventory entries, the committed document, runtime options, and the run summary, plus derived decode/encode codecs. DualArityInventoryEntry class is file-private but its declare-namespace (Encoded type) is exported; Options/Summary are public.

concerns.name: Pure inventory-domain helpers
concerns.description: Entry keys, ordering, sorting, date stamping, and file/name exclusion + enforcement predicates over the inventory document.

concerns.name: ts-morph AST analysis primitives
concerns.description: Pure ts-morph machinery: dual-import binding index, dual()/Effect.fn call detection, expression unwrapping, call-signature arity/dual-shape checks, strict-ObjectLike type predicates, tagged-template filtering, and the legitimate-constructor-factory exemption gates.

concerns.name: Candidate collection and diagnosis
concerns.description: Walks each SourceFile's exported functions, variable statements, and public static class members into PublicApiCandidate records, then derives per-candidate DualArityDiagnosticKind lists and inventory entries.

concerns.name: Workspace owner resolution
concerns.description: Effectful factory resolving an absolute file path to its owning @beep/* workspace via resolveWorkspaceDirs with hardcoded fallbacks; SchemaFirst.ts explicitly mirrors it.

concerns.name: Inventory persistence I/O
concerns.description: FileSystem/Path effects: jsonc-parser read + schema decode with DualArityInventoryReadError on parse failure, and encode + renderBiomeJson write of the baseline document.

concerns.name: Diagnostic message rendering
concerns.description: Match-based human messages per diagnostic kind and the [missing]/[stale]/[enforced]/[invalid-exception] line formatters, plus the Console.log/Console.error reporting block inside runDualArityRules.

concerns.name: Scan orchestration and verification entry
concerns.description: TSMorphService project inspection wiring, live-vs-tracked merge preserving status/owner/reason/issue, missing/stale/enforced/invalid-exception set computation, strict-failure policy, and summary construction — the only effectful public entrypoint.

proposedSplit.contents: Keeps its exact path (it is a committed enforcedRoot in standards/dual-arity.inventory.jsonc) and remains the law entrypoint: runDualArityRules, scanDualArityInventory, mergeInventory, strict-failure policy, plus re-exports of DualArityRulesOptions/DualArityRulesSummary/DualArityInventoryEntry namespace so Laws.command.ts and the Laws.test-kit star-export keep working unchanged.

DualArityEntryKind/Status/DiagnosticKind LiteralKits, DualArityInventoryEntry (+Encoded namespace), DualArityInventoryDocument, DualArityRulesOptions, DualArityRulesSummary, decode/encode codecs, and the INVENTORY_PATH/INCLUDED_GLOBS/ENFORCED_ROOTS constants the document defaults depend on. Keep the $I key string 'commands/Laws/DualArity' to preserve schema identifiers.

Pure ts-morph primitives: collectDualBindings, getDualCallInfo, unwrapExpression, isParameterOwner, getEffectFnImplementation, getInitializerParameterOwner, signature/arity helpers (hasDualSignatures, getNonTemplateCallSignatures, isTaggedTemplateSignature, getThirdParameterType, getCallableParameterCount), type predicates (isStrictObjectLikeType, isPrimitiveType), the legitimate-constructor-factory gates, isPipeableParameter/hasObviousWrongFirstParameter, and the heuristic regex constants.

PublicApiCandidate/DualBindingIndex/DualCallInfo types, the four collect*Candidate walkers, collectCandidatesForSourceFile, collectCandidateDiagnostics, makeInventoryEntry, isExcludedPublicApiName, and makeOwnerResolver.

Baseline persistence and bookkeeping: readInventoryDocument (jsonc parse + DualArityInventoryReadError), writeInventoryDocument (renderBiomeJson), makeEntryKey, sortEntries/orders, todayYmd, isExcludedFile, isEnforcedFile, getInvalidExceptions.

diagnosticMessage Match table, makeReason, the four make*Diagnostics line formatters, and a reportDualAritySummary helper absorbing the Console.log/Console.error block currently inlined in runDualArityRules.

sharedCandidates.description: UTC YYYY-MM-DD stamp via DateTime; duplicated verbatim at src/commands/Lint/SchemaFirst.ts:521. Belongs in a shared cli util or @beep/repo-utils.

File-path -> owning @beep/* workspace resolver built on resolveWorkspaceDirs with longest-path-first matching; SchemaFirst.ts:581 explicitly says its makeSchemaFirstOwnerResolver mirrors this by design. Promote once to @beep/repo-utils/Workspaces or a shared cli helper.

The jsonc-read + schema-decode + key-merge-preserving-status/owner/reason + renderBiomeJson-write pattern is structurally duplicated by Lint/SchemaFirst.ts (inventoryEntriesByKey, inventoryEntriesAbsentFrom, its own read/write against standards/schema-first.inventory.jsonc). A generic helper parameterized by entry schema + key function would serve both.

Peels parenthesized/as/satisfies/non-null wrappers from ts-morph nodes; TerseEffect.ts:452 has a narrower unwrapParenthesizedExpression variant. Generic ts-morph utility, candidate for @beep/repo-utils/TSMorph.
Provider-agnostic ts-morph Type/Signature predicates with no dual-arity semantics; useful to any ts-morph-based law or lint. Candidate for @beep/repo-utils/TSMorph.

risks: Self-enforcement feedback loop: ENFORCED_ROOTS and the committed standards/dual-arity.inventory.jsonc enforcedRoots (line 6) name the exact path .../Laws/DualArity.ts, and mergeInventory prefers the committed enforcedRoots — the entry file must keep its path, or both the constant and the baseline must be updated together.

Helpers promoted from file-private const to module export in internal/ files become live scan candidates of the law itself (the scan covers packages/**/*.ts and checks module-level isExported, not package facades); multi-positional-parameter collectors (e.g. collectStaticPropertyCandidate with 6 params) would surface as new missing entries and fail --check strict mode until the inventory is regenerated with --write or the internal/ paths are excluded.

src/test/Laws.test-kit.ts star-exports DualArity and test/dual-arity.test.ts consumes DualArityRulesOptions/runDualArityRules through @beep/repo-cli/test/Laws — the facade must re-export them, and adding more star-exports risks duplicate-name collisions across the kit's seven star-exports.

$I = $RepoCliId.create("commands/Laws/DualArity") is baked into schema identifiers and the S.Class keys; moving schemas to internal/DualArity.schemas.ts must keep the same $I string or the identifiers of DualArityInventoryEntry/Document change (affects decode error messages and any identity-based tooling).

DualArityInventoryEntry is a non-exported class merged with an exported declare-namespace (Encoded type); the pair must move together and encoded field shape must stay byte-compatible with the committed jsonc baseline (renderBiomeJson output is committed and diffed).

Docgen/JSDoc lint gates: every new file needs a @packageDocumentation header and exported symbols need @example/@category/@since annotations (repo runs docgen + jsdoc lint); also the cli package facade rules treat deep role files as private, so index.ts must not export the new internal/ modules.
